consent_purposes.description: Explicit consent for promotional or marketing email communication.
Explicit consent for promotional or marketing SMS communication.

processors.data_location: EEA contracting via Stripe Technology Europe Ltd; US processing via Stripe LLC
processors.transfer_mechanism: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (Stripe LLC certified) + EU SCCs as backup
processors.notes: Stores charge, payout, and financial operations data. Default payment provider (provider-agnostic interface). DPA auto-incorporated via ToS: https://stripe.com/legal/dpa . DPF policy: https://stripe.com/legal/data-privacy-framework — confirm our acceptance/execution.
Primary geo/routing provider (affiliated EU SaaS, same founder). Processes pickup/drop-off addresses and route requests. Execute an Art. 28 DPA even though affiliated.

processors.transfer_mechanism: Intra-EEA (TomTom International BV, Netherlands); no third-country transfer
processors.notes: Configured fallback routing provider behind FastGeo. EEA-based controller/processor; standard DPA review.

processors.transfer_mechanism: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (Google LLC certified) + EU SCCs
processors.notes: Used for mobile push delivery via the Herald notification service. Firebase Data Processing & Security Terms: https://firebase.google.com/terms/data-processing-terms . SCCs: https://firebase.google.com/terms/firebase-sccs

processors.transfer_mechanism: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (Twilio Inc. certified) + Binding Corporate Rules + EU SCCs
processors.notes: Used for transactional and safety SMS messaging. DPA: https://www.twilio.com/en-us/legal/data-protection-addendum

processors.service_area: Edge workers, CDN, and object storage (R2)
processors.transfer_mechanism: EU-US Data Privacy Framework certified + EU SCCs
processors.notes: Hosts the public dashboard, auth-gate and public-site Workers + CDN; R2 is the planned storage target for exported compliance evidence bundles. DPA: https://www.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-customer-dpa/ . Sub-processors: https://www.cloudflare.com/gdpr/subprocessors/
Hosts the primary PostgreSQL database (IONOS A) and gps-ingest + Dragonfly cache (IONOS B). German provider — primary data residency for platform personal data.
Hosts pillion-core and the Go microservices (ride-matcher, compass, herald, prefactguard, price-arbiter, regula) plus a local Redis. German provider.

retention_policies.description: User profile, contact, and account-state records for active users.
retention_policies.storage_scope: Monolith user store and identity provider
retention_policies.deletion_method: Anonymise on erasure; retain only legally required records
retention_policies.notes: Profile retained for the lifetime of the account, then anonymised per the Article 17 erasure saga.

retention_policies.description: Published legal document versions and publication history.
retention_policies.deletion_method: Retain indefinitely unless legal counsel approves archival deletion
retention_policies.notes: Canonical legal texts should generally remain available for historical proof.

retention_policies.description: Consent grants and revocations linked to legal text versions.
retention_policies.deletion_method: Retain for accountability period, then archive/delete per counsel guidance
retention_policies.notes: Avoid deleting while claims or regulatory disputes remain possible.

retention_policies.deletion_method: Retain for accountability period, then archive/delete per counsel guidance
retention_policies.notes: Acceptance records should stay available to prove which terms were accepted.

retention_policies.description: Uploaded driver identity, license, and regulatory documents.
retention_policies.deletion_method: Delete from active storage and purge backups per retention window
retention_policies.notes: Validate exact retention with local counsel.

retention_policies.description: Live and historical trip location telemetry.
retention_policies.notes: Short retention strongly preferred unless incident evidence requires extension.

retention_policies.description: Trip metadata: timestamps, distance, fare, status (location coordinates excluded).
retention_policies.deletion_method: Delete/anonymise after the accounting and tax retention window
retention_policies.legal_basis: Legal obligation (tax and accounting) and legal defense
retention_policies.notes: Coordinates are purged separately on the 30-day cycle; metadata follows tax retention.

retention_policies.description: Charge, capture, payout, refund, and reconciliation records.
retention_policies.deletion_method: Retain for the statutory accounting period, then delete
retention_policies.notes: amount_cents and reconciliation evidence kept pristine for the full window.

retention_policies.description: Customer support interactions, disputes, and refund reviews.
retention_policies.storage_scope: Support tooling and monolith case records
retention_policies.legal_basis: Contract, legal defense, and fraud handling
retention_policies.notes: Longer retention may be justified for chargeback defense.

retention_policies.description: Consent state and history for marketing channels.
retention_policies.deletion_method: Retain until withdrawal plus a short accountability period, then archive
retention_policies.notes: Append-only; each change is a new event row.

retention_policies.description: Encrypted database and object backups containing platform data.
retention_policies.notes: Backups must follow the shortest viable rolling window.

processing_activities.purpose: Authenticate platform users, manage sessions, secure access, and maintain account state.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Identity data, account identifiers, authentication metadata, role assignments
processing_activities.recipient_categories: Self-hosted identity service (Zitadel on EU VPS), hosting providers, support staff
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Identity is self-hosted on EU VPS (IONOS/Hetzner, Germany); no third-country transfer for identity data.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain account and access records while account is active, then follow account closure and security retention rules.
processing_activities.security_measures: OIDC, role-based access, service-to-service auth, audit logging, TLS, environment-secret controls

processing_activities.purpose: Match passengers and drivers, operate live trips, and support safety monitoring.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Location data, trip metadata, route history, driver status, passenger pickup/drop-off data
processing_activities.recipient_categories: Compass, FastGeo, TomTom, drivers, passengers, safety/support staff
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Geolocation requires DPIA review and strict retention limits.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Live tracking retained briefly (30 days); trip metadata retained per accounting and dispute policy.
processing_activities.security_measures: Short-lived tracking tokens, internal service auth, limited retention, operational access controls

processing_activities.purpose: Process passenger payments, driver payouts, refunds, and financial audit trails.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Payment references, payout status, transaction metadata, refund evidence
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Vendor and transfer position must align with finance and processor review.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain according to accounting, refund, and legal defense requirements (up to 10 years).
processing_activities.security_measures: Processor isolation, webhook verification, least-privilege finance access, audit trails

processing_activities.purpose: Review driver documents, background checks, and qualification state before activation.
processing_activities.legal_basis: Contract, legal obligation, and legitimate interests
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Identity documents, licensing data, qualification records, screening outcomes, notes
processing_activities.recipient_categories: PrefactGuard (internal trust-and-safety service), compliance/admin staff, support staff
processing_activities.transfer_notes: High-risk data category requiring DPIA review. Screening handled by the internal PrefactGuard service (same controller, EU VPS) — no external background-check processor in use.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain according to legal/regulatory obligations and approved retention policy.
processing_activities.security_measures: Restricted admin access, document verification workflow, status audit trail, encrypted storage

processing_activities.purpose: Handle SOS alerts, share live location with emergency contacts, and support incident response during trips.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Real-time location, emergency contact details, incident metadata, safety-checklist responses
processing_activities.recipient_categories: Safety/support staff, emergency contacts, SMS provider, competent authorities where required
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Minimise data shared; share only what an emergency requires.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain incident evidence for the dispute/legal window; otherwise follow location retention.
processing_activities.security_measures: Restricted access, audit logging, encrypted transport, least-data sharing

processing_activities.purpose: Respond to user enquiries, resolve disputes, process refunds, and handle chargebacks.
processing_activities.legal_basis: Contract, legal obligation, and legitimate interests
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Contact details, ticket content, trip and payment references, correspondence
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Keep tooling within reviewed vendors; limit access to handling staff.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Up to 3 years from case closure; longer for chargeback defense.
processing_activities.security_measures: Role-based access, audit trail, correlation IDs across systems

processing_activities.purpose: Send service messages (bookings, receipts, OTP, lifecycle notices) and, with consent, marketing.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Contact details, push tokens, communication preferences, consent state
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Push/SMS providers are non-EEA; rely on SCCs and transfer assessments.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Transactional logs per service need; marketing consent until withdrawn plus accountability period.
processing_activities.security_measures: Consent enforcement, suppression lists, provider DPAs, append-only consent ledger

processing_activities.purpose: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and policy violations; protect users and the platform.
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Trust signals, device and session data, trip/payment patterns, decision outcomes
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Internal trust service; review any external enrichment vendors before use.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain decision evidence for the dispute/legal window.
processing_activities.security_measures: Fail-closed eligibility checks, audited admin overrides, least-privilege access

processing_activities.purpose: Store legal texts, acceptance evidence, and consent history for accountability and disputes.
processing_activities.legal_basis: Legal obligation, accountability, and legitimate interests
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Consent events, acceptance events, document versions, evidence metadata
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Keep evidence service internal-only and review storage vendor positions.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain according to accountability and legal defense policy.
processing_activities.security_measures: Internal-only API, machine auth, audit logging, append-only event design

processing_activities.purpose: Operate the data protection programme: handle data-subject requests, maintain the RoPA, run DPIAs, manage processors and breach response.
processing_activities.data_subject_categories: All data subjects (via requests and complaints)
processing_activities.personal_data_categories: Request and complaint records, identity-verification evidence, breach records
processing_activities.recipient_categories: Data Protection Officer, compliance staff, supervisory authority where required
processing_activities.transfer_notes: Records kept internal; shared with the supervisory authority on request.
processing_activities.retention_summary: Retain request and breach records for the accountability and limitation period.
processing_activities.security_measures: Restricted access, audit logging, documented procedures, append-only ledgers

dpia_records.summary: DPIA covering live trip tracking, driver monitoring, and background-check-related processing before launch.
dpia_records.scope: Compass tracking, monolith location handling, driver compliance workflows, screening processors, safety escalation flows
dpia_records.mitigating_measures: Minimize retention (30-day location purge), restrict operational access, audit admin actions, verify vendor contracts, document lawful basis and necessity, and define incident response.

dpia_records.summary: DPIA for automated and semi-automated evaluation of driver eligibility and trust signals (GDPR Art. 22).
dpia_records.scope: PrefactGuard trust scoring, fail-closed eligibility gating, admin override path, onboarding decisioning
dpia_records.mitigating_measures: Provide human review on request, log and audit overrides, document logic and significance, limit signal retention, and inform data subjects in the privacy and rights notices.
